title: Human Capabilities as Guiding Lights for the Field of AI-HRI: Insights from Engineering Education
reasoning: The paper uses the Engineering for Social Justice (E4SJ) framework and Nussbaum's human capabilities approach to evaluate the research practices in the field of AI-HRI. It fundamentally discusses the ethics of research direction, the AAAI Code of Ethics, and how to align technical development with moral and social justice goals.
